cycles.justification: Present at the 2026-09-25 baseline (Founder disposition finding 4). Declared edge for edge so that it is explicit and cannot grow silently; any new edge into or out of this group that closes a cycle fails. Minimization and justification against bounded-context ownership remain open review work; no broad refactor is authorized.
